race.comment: CAPITANO (1) is a Bivouac colt from Angasi on debut for the Michael Freedman yard. Produced solid figures when he swamped them late to run second in a 850m trial at Randwick Kensington. Makes plenty of appeal over the 1000m. NONU (8) is a nicely bred colt by first season sire Anamoe from the stakes-winning mare Easifar on debut for the Baker stable. Showed good early speed to sit up on the pace before clearing out for a commanding trial win over 850m at Randwick Kensington. From an in form yard and ticks a few boxes from the draw. STASIS (10) is a first starter by State Of Rest out of Matronymic from the Waterhouse & Bott yard. Showed ability with a recent trial placing over 850m at Randwick Kensington. Respect. FLYING HOUDINI (5) Trapeze Artist colt from Misplaced on debut for the Waterhouse & Bott yard. Won a recent Randwick Kensington trial over 850m and maps well.
